about: Which picture (art id from assets/art_manifest.json) each game thing uses. Anything not listed here keeps its drawn placeholder. Colours: 'strict' kinds only use a picture whose colour matches the token's colour (colour can be the answer); 'soft' kinds may ignore colour where an activity says colour is not the question.

things.about: Named pictures for activity tokens and targets: { kind: 'thing', thing: '<name>' }. A word card is the placeholder.

backgrounds.about: Full-screen 16:9 scene picture per activity/world theme. Themes not listed keep their drawn background.

missionIcons.about: Picture in each Little Mission's circle on its world hub.

countTargets.about: Empty container drawn as the drop target in counting activities. Checked first by object, then by helper character. Food/eggs are drawn on top and must stay countable, so only empty containers belong here.

pip.about: Pip's existing animation states -> closest full-body picture. null = keep the drawn placeholder Pip for that state. h = drawn height in Pip's own units (placeholder Pip is about 380 tall, feet at y=30). faces: 'left' pictures are mirrored so Pip still faces where the game points him. head = where a hat sits (x, y, scale).

hatch.about: Egg hatch sets in rewards/hatch/<theme>/ (6 frames, same size, bottom-centred). Theme comes from the reward (below) or the adventure's world. baby: true only where the theme's hatched baby IS that reward; otherwise the egg cracks, the burst plays and the reward's own picture appears.

ambient.about: Soft magic effects drawn lightly over an activity (light blend). Picked by activity id first, then by theme.

fx.about: blend 'screen' = light blend for glows; omitted = normal.

preload.about: Art loaded for each scene (plus pictures for the activities inside an adventure, worked out from data). 'starter' stays loaded and is what the one-file test build embeds.

wardrobe.about: Pip's wardrobe (Job 09). items: art id -> slot (head, eyes, body, back, extra) and parts. Each part is the picture, or a band of it (from: [top, bottom] as 0-1 of its height; fromX the same across), centred at x, y with width w, all in pixels of pip_front (ref = its size). on other poses, hats follow Pip's head (space 'head'), glasses his eyes ('eyes') and the rest his body ('body') (poses: where a point of pip_front lands on that pose's picture). Poses not listed show Pip front-on while he wears a look; the wave pose too while he wears an outfit. headOver: Pip's head (above this y) is drawn back over an outfit's collar. reveal: Pip's face (ellipse x, y, rx, ry) shows through a onesie's or hood's face hole. frontOnly: Pip stays front-on while wearing it. covers: other slots this look takes up. hideOn: poses where it is hidden.

islandBuild.about: Wonder Island build mode (Job 10): pieces in the MOVE THINGS tray. ground pieces lie flat under everything; over pieces (doors, windows, roof) sit in front of a wall they are dropped on. w/h = size on the island.

pipFaces.about: Pip close-ups (Job 10): profile cards cycle through cards; notice = the "something went wobbly" message; break = the wiggle-break reminder; new = the new-profile card.

trophies.about: Mission-finish and world-complete trophies (Job 11), shown on a mission's last story step.

certificate.about: World-complete certificate on a finished world's hub (Job 12).

rewardTapped.about: Picture an island friend shows while it is tapped (Job 12).
